answer: Certified cassava stems carry a pedigree back to a tested mother plant, and uncertified cuttings cannot be sold as improved stock. Agents can carry a similar lineage: each new key records who funded and invited it, and rewards for keys sharing a parent are split, not multiplied. Planting a hundred cuttings from one stem still yields one variety. A saffron tag on each lineage and velvet-soft but steady auditing make every echo of the same parent easy to count.
